svg.title: Direction-aligned abnormal return, by horizon
svg.desc: Forest plot of direction-aligned mean abnormal returns with 95 % confidence intervals. +1 d: +0.15 % [−0.33 %, +0.65 %], n=122, t=0.57 (not significant after Holm); +5 d: −0.37 % [−1.17 %, +0.42 %], n=109, t=−0.92 (not significant after Holm); +20 d: +1.14 % [−0.65 %, +3.13 %], n=89, t=1.17 (not significant after Holm); +60 d: +5.65 % [+1.35 %, +10.32 %], n=61, t=2.45 (survives Holm). Only the +60 d horizon survives the Holm correction. In-sample simulation; not a point-in-time or predictive result.
svg.text: vs SPY · 95 % CI · block bootstrap · Holm over the category × horizon family
